name: cache-invalidation-lab
description: Lab bài 03/02: Cache Invalidation (TTL + outbox + chỉ mục ngược) cho giá sản phẩm trên NestJS 10, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7

scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d shop -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v products=${PRODUCTS:-20000} -f /lab/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U app -d shop
scripts.job:csv: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d shop -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /lab/sql/${VARIANT:-sau}/import-prices.sql
